hypotheses.mechanism: Dissolve separate receipt plumbing into first-class typed transition records with causal/outcome/reentry fields.
hypotheses.expected_gain: fewer module boundaries and fewer partial receipt states
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: explicit separated receipts are easier to audit and recover
hypotheses.counterprediction: fusion increases corruption blast radius or obscures failed stages
hypotheses.falsifier: fault injection shows worse localization/recovery than separated receipt baseline
hypotheses.minimum_test: paired replay with dropped/corrupt receipt stages
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: receipts remain multiple explicit lifecycle objects

hypotheses.mechanism: Construct an epoch-bound graph whose edges exist only when two typed transitions fail to commute on the current state; noncommuting connected components become transient coordination cells.
hypotheses.problem_target: false global coupling and unnecessary serialization
hypotheses.expected_gain: semantic independence, dynamic module boundaries, less broadcast/serial work
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: ordinary read/write conflict graph plus fixed GWT
hypotheses.counterprediction: commutator cost dominates and adds no useful independence
hypotheses.falsifier: resource-matched replay shows no safe-independence gain or any unsafe commuting classification
hypotheses.minimum_test: synthetic typed transition differential against full two-order replay and conflict graph
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: GWT scores candidates but has no state-dependent order-sensitivity topology

hypotheses.mechanism: Phase-latch recurrence so each unresolved pressure class has a refractory phase and only cross-phase residuals can re-enter immediately.
hypotheses.expected_gain: bounded recurrence without global hard depth cap
hypotheses.falsifier: matched replay shows no improvement over one scalar reentry inhibition
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: current loop controls do not expose typed phase classes

hypotheses.mechanism: Broadcast only a typed semantic delta basis plus reconstruction hash; receivers materialize only dimensions they consume.
hypotheses.expected_gain: lower broadcast bytes/tokens and receiver work
hypotheses.counterprediction: novelty collapses to conventional serialization optimization
hypotheses.falsifier: resource-matched encoding gives no net latency/context gain
hypotheses.minimum_test: replay broadcasts under full vs lazy delta reconstruction
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: broadcast semantic granularity is not receiver-lazy

hypotheses.mechanism: For eligible internal decisions create a no-effect shadow transition and compare outcome delta before causal credit admission.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: existing verified outcome plus causal receipts
hypotheses.counterprediction: shadow adds cost without changing admitted credit
hypotheses.falsifier: lesion shows identical credit errors at lower cost
hypotheses.minimum_test: frozen episode replay with shuffled shadows
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: causal receipts do not require explicit paired no-effect worlds

hypotheses.mechanism: Represent unresolved pressure and control response as conjugate variables with approximately area-preserving internal updates, adding damping only at verified outcome boundaries.
hypotheses.expected_gain: preserve useful exploratory dynamics while bounding dissipation
hypotheses.counterprediction: symplectic metaphor adds complexity with no predictive benefit
hypotheses.falsifier: matched loop simulations show no regime discrimination or stability gain
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: current controls use gains/habituation rather than conjugate state geometry

hypotheses.mechanism: Address memory by a joint residual-pressure/goal/world-state basin signature rather than query similarity alone.
hypotheses.expected_gain: state-relevant retrieval and fewer generic nearest-neighbor hits
hypotheses.counterprediction: basin signatures are unstable and overfit state encoding
hypotheses.falsifier: held-out episodes show lower recall/calibration than hybrid retrieval
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: retrieval is not explicitly keyed by dynamical basin

hypotheses.mechanism: Each candidate bids expected verified information/progress gain per marginal resource unit; budgets clear at typed opportunity frontiers.
hypotheses.problem_target: compute allocation across proactive goals and cognition
hypotheses.expected_gain: better useful progress per token/CPU/tool call
hypotheses.falsifier: shadow scheduler loses to simple priority under matched workload
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: current selection mixes relevance/impact but not explicit marginal resource clearing

hypotheses.mechanism: Make effect summaries compositional algebraic values whose commutation, reversibility and authority properties are checked by the compiler.
hypotheses.expected_gain: static rejection of hidden authority escalation and safe reordering
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: ordinary effect types plus runtime gates
hypotheses.counterprediction: algebra adds no accepted programs or catches no extra violations
hypotheses.falsifier: mutation corpus shows no diagnostic or optimization delta
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: effect authority is typed but semantic commutation is not first-class

hypotheses.mechanism: Represent unresolved mutually exclusive hypotheses as a typed simplex retaining conflict mass and explicit unallocated UNKNOWN mass.
hypotheses.expected_gain: better alternative preservation and calibrated abstention
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: Hyperposition set-valued alternatives plus scalar confidence
hypotheses.falsifier: no decision/calibration gain under contradiction fixtures
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: alternatives are preserved but normalized conflict mass is not a core state geometry

hypotheses.mechanism: Dormant goals form evidence-sensitive wake surfaces; new evidence propagates only along dependency edges until a wake threshold is crossed.
hypotheses.expected_gain: less periodic scanning and targeted proactive reactivation
hypotheses.counterprediction: ordinary event indexing is simpler and equivalent
hypotheses.falsifier: no resource/latency advantage over indexed wake conditions
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: wake conditions exist but are not propagated as graded dependency surfaces

hypotheses.mechanism: Represent perceptual memory primarily as verified task-bound state-action-state transition operators, with snapshots as evidence attachments rather than the main semantic unit.
hypotheses.problem_target: visual aliasing and repeated GUI reasoning
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: q23 VSTG plus conventional snapshot retrieval
hypotheses.counterprediction: this is equivalent to the live q23 VSTG or worsens partial observability
hypotheses.falsifier: q23 matched replay shows no distinct mechanism gain
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: q23 is now actively exploring this, so duplicate invention risk is high
